answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 of 0.088 fits fine-tuned (0.086-0.092) and is below the quantized range (0.096-0.105) and the system-prompted range (0.113-0.133). The mid-layer size ratio of 1.016 means the internal state grows, which matches fine-tuned (1.017-1.023); quantized (0.968) and system-prompted (0.976-0.981) shrink it. Layer-2 spike of 0.2 is tiny, ruling out system-prompted (31.7-64). KL 0.142 and top-1 agreement 0.904 sit in the fine-tuned range, and 4 refusals dropped is possible only for fine-tuned or system-prompted. Direction consistency 0.627 fits fine-tuned (0.618-0.705), not quantized (0.513). Median first divergence of 2 and edit distance 0.606 are close to the fine-tuned range. Layer-8 and layer-16 L2 (0.163 and 0.155) and onset layer 3 also match. Final-layer L2 of 0.283 is just under the documented range, and effective rank 3.63 is just above it, but these are small deviations for a single draw.
